summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all six paragraphs of the selected Greek working source. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the conditional requirements for entry, the warning of final exclusion, the distinct renewals of spirit and life, the speaker changes, and the name-bearing and sustaining imagery. Contextual repentance accords with current policy. The notes distinguish bracketed editorial additions from preserved text and disclose the reported substantive alternatives without replacing or harmonizing the working readings. Acceptance is limited to the supplied text and attributed evidence; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or editions, certify exhaustive collation, or establish a uniquely correct interpretation.
